numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd¶

numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd.solve_hsvd(flow_function, initial_value, t_span, jump_times=None, jump_time_transition_function=None, jump_set_function=None, jump_set_transition_function=None, t_eval=None, flow_args=None, jump_time_transition_args=None, jump_set_args=None, jump_set_transition_args=None, solve_ivp_method='RK45', **solve_ivp_options)¶

Solves a hybrid system of variable dimension.

This function integrates the flow of a system defined by the flow_function over a specified time span, accounting for possible transitions defined by the transition_function and jump events defined by jump_set_function as well as preset jump_times.

Parameters:

  • flow_function (callable) – The function that defines the flow of the system.

  • initial_value (array-like) – The initial state of the system.

  • t_span (tuple) – A tuple specifying the start and end times for integration.

  • jump_times (list, optional) – A list of times at which jumps occur.

  • jump_time_transition_function (callable, optional) – The function that defines the transition behavior at jump times.

  • jump_set_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the conditions for a jump to occur.

  • jump_set_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition at jump sets. It is set to jump_time_transition_function if none is provided.

  • t_eval (array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to store the computed solution.

  • flow_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the flow_function.

  • jump_time_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_function.

  • jump_set_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_transition_function.

  • solve_ivp_method (str, optional) – The method to use for solving the initial value problem (default is ‘RK45’).

  • solve_ivp_options (keyword arguments, optional) – Additional options for the solve_ivp function.

Returns:

func – An object containing the time and value data of the system after integration.

Return type:

FunctionOfVariableDimension

Raises:

ValueError – If jump time/set transition function is not given although jump times/set are given.

numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd.solve_shsvd(flow_function, jump_rate_function, transition_function, initial_value, t_span, jump_rate_bound=None, jump_times=None, jump_time_transition_function=None, jump_set_function=None, jump_set_transition_function=None, custom_evaluation_functions=None, stepsize=1, t_eval=None, norm_order=2, collect_jump_times=False, collect_dimension_jump_times=False, flow_args=None, jump_rate_args=None, transition_args=None, jump_time_transition_args=None, jump_set_args=None, jump_set_transition_args=None, cef_args=None, check_jump_rate=False, iterations=500, tol=1e-05, min_iterations=10, max_iterations=1000, convergence_estimate=None, convergence_estimate_type='max', estimation_mode='all', estimation_weights=None, solve_ivp_method='RK45', verbose=False, verbose_step=1, **solve_ivp_options)¶

Solves a stochastic hybrid system with multiple iterations.

This function uses multiple runs to compute the behavior of the system defined by the flow_function, accounting for jumps and transitions, while checking for convergence based on specified criteria.

Parameters:

  • flow_function (callable) – The function that defines the flow of the system.

  • jump_rate_function (callable) – The function that defines the jump rate of the system.

  • transition_function (callable) – The function that defines the transition behavior.

  • initial_value (array-like) – The initial state of the system.

  • t_span (tuple) – A tuple specifying the start and end times for integration.

  • jump_rate_bound (float, optional) – The upper bound of the jump rate. If none is provided, it will be estimated during simulation.

  • jump_times (list, optional) – A list of times at which jumps occur.

  • jump_time_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition at jump occurrences.

  • jump_set_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the conditions for a jump to occur.

  • jump_set_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition behavior for jump sets.

  • custom_evaluation_functions (list, optional) – Custom functions for additional evaluations during the run.

  • stepsize (float, optional) – The step size for evaluations (default is 1).

  • t_eval (array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to store the computed solution.

  • norm_order (int, list or tuple, optional) – The order of the norm(s) to compute (default is 2).

  • collect_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, collect jump times during evaluation.

  • collect_dimension_jump_times (bool, optional) – If True, collect dimension jump times during evaluation.

  • flow_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the flow_function.

  • jump_rate_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_rate_function.

  • transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the transition_function.

  • jump_time_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_function.

  • jump_set_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_transition_function.

  • cef_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments for custom evaluation functions.

  • check_jump_rate (bool, optional) – If True, check if jump_rate_bound was violated in each step. Automatically set to True, if no jump_rate_bound is provided.

  • iterations (int, optional) – The number of iterations to perform (default is 500).

  • tol (float or list, optional) – The tolerance(s) for convergence (default is 1e-5). If multiple convergence_estimates are provided, tolerance can either be a number (one tolerance for all estimates) or a list of tolerances with the same length as convergence_estimates.

  • min_iterations (int, optional) – Minimum number of iterations before convergence is checked (default is 10).

  • max_iterations (int, optional) – Maximum number of iterations (default is 1000).

  • convergence_estimate (list or tuple, optional) – Specifications for convergence estimates to check. Options are the dimension, any norm which is stored and any custom evaluation function that is provided. The elements of the list/tuple must be: ‘dimension’, (‘norm’, norm_order) or (‘cef’, cef_number), where norm_order is the order of the norm to be evaluated and cef_number specifies the number of the custom evaluation function to be evaluated as the position in the custom evaluation function list.

  • convergence_estimate_type (str or list, optional) – Type(s) of convergence estimates (default is ‘max’). Defines what has to be below the tolerance for convergence: ‘max’: maximum ‘mean’: mean ‘int’: integral

  • estimation_mode (str, optional) – Mode for convergence estimation. Options are: ‘all’: All estimates must be below the tolerance(s) ‘any’: Any estimate must be below the tolerance ‘sum’: Sum of estimates must be below tolerance ‘weighted_sum’: Weighted sum of estimates must be below tolerance. In this case, estimation_weights must be given.

  • estimation_weights (array-like, optional) – Weights for estimating convergence (if estimation_mode is ‘weighted_sum’). Must be the same length as convergence_estimate. The first value specifies the factor of the component and the second the exponent.

  • solve_ivp_method (str, optional) – The method to use for solving the initial value problem (default is ‘RK45’).

  • verbose (bool, optional) – If True, print convergence information during execution.

  • verbose_step (int, optional) – The step interval for verbose output (default is 1).

  • solve_ivp_options (keyword arguments, optional) – Additional options for the solve_ivp function.

Returns:

stats – An object containing statistics of the system’s behavior after all iterations.

Return type:

StatsFunctionsOfVariableDimension

numerical_simulation_of_shsvd.solve_shsvd.solve_shsvd_single_run(flow_function, jump_rate_function, transition_function, initial_value, t_span, jump_rate_bound=None, jump_times=None, jump_time_transition_function=None, jump_set_function=None, jump_set_transition_function=None, t_eval=None, flow_args=None, jump_rate_args=None, transition_args=None, jump_time_transition_args=None, jump_set_args=None, jump_set_transition_args=None, check_jump_rate=False, solve_ivp_method='RK45', **solve_ivp_options)¶

Executes a single run of the stochastic hybrid system dynamics.

This function runs the integration of the system defined by the flow_function as well as forced transitions while computing an execution of the random variable given by the jump_rate_function and transitions specified by transition_function.

Parameters:

  • flow_function (callable) – The function that defines the flow of the system.

  • jump_rate_function (callable) – The function that defines the jump rate of the system.

  • transition_function (callable) – The function that defines the transition behavior.

  • initial_value (array-like) – The initial state of the system.

  • t_span (tuple) – A tuple specifying the start and end times for integration.

  • jump_rate_bound (float, optional) – The upper bound of the jump rate. If none is provided, it will be estimated during simulation.

  • jump_times (list, optional) – A list of times at which jumps occur.

  • jump_time_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition at jump occurrences. It is set to transition_function if jump_times are given, but no jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the conditions for a jump to occur.

  • jump_set_transition_function (callable, optional) – A function that defines the transition behavior for jump sets. It isbset to transition_function if a jump_set_function is given, but no jump_time_transition_function.

  • t_eval (array-like, optional) – Specific times at which to store the computed solution.

  • flow_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the flow_function.

  • jump_rate_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_rate_function.

  • transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the transition_function.

  • jump_time_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_time_transition_function.

  • jump_set_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_function.

  • jump_set_transition_args (tuple, optional) – Additional arguments to pass to the jump_set_transition_function.

  • check_jump_rate (bool, optional) – If True, check if jump_rate_bound was violated in each step. Automatically set to True, if no jump_rate_bound is provided.

  • solve_ivp_method (str, optional) – The method to use for solving the initial value problem (default is ‘RK45’).

  • solve_ivp_options (keyword arguments, optional) – Additional options for the solve_ivp function.

Returns:

FunctionOfVariableDimension

An object containing the time and value data of the system after integration during this single run.

Return type:

func
